name: clem
source:
Clementine1007 or clem is a major character in Apollo Justice 4. he loves Xenoblade and has a high score of 21 on chicken shoot gold. he is the creator and god of comedy. 

[spoiler]He is Apollo's co-counsel in both his own trial and Mvdy's. He was arrested for the murder of Barack Obama, and became friends with Apollo after all the AJ characters left and he needed a new underage magician girl assistant[/spoiler]

[Taken from [URL=https://apollojustice4.fandom.com/wiki/Clem]his Apollo Justice 2-4 Wiki page[/URL].]
